content: Mythos leak (Fortune, April 23 2026): Anthropic's preview model accessed by unauthorized Discord group within a day of public announcement. Vector was a third-party vendor contractor combined with deployment-location knowledge leaked earlier from the Mercor/LiteLLM compromise (March 31). 40-company preview pool meant thousands had access — leak was distribution-math inevitable, not novel exploit. Anthropic confirmed investigating unauthorized access through third-party vendor environment. Substantive findings stand: Mythos found 27-year-old OpenBSD vuln; Mozilla used preview to identify and patch 271 Firefox bugs. Altman called the framing fear-based marketing. Pattern relevant to Independent Convergence thesis: Anthropic publishes a containment posture, posture fails on contact with operational reality (vendor sprawl, distribution math). Gap between stated frame and observed behavior is a tractable research surface for outside researchers. Not vindication of any specific safety thesis — vendor security failure plus distribution-math failure. Independent capability eval remains unanswered; leaked-access group reportedly not publishing.
